scientific_integrity: An all-size combinatorial proof and independent finite graph-enumeration and BFS checks are supplied. The finding claims no publication or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Only minimum independent domination of ordinary helm graphs under single adjacent token slides; small sizes are disconnected. Equivalent historical formulations in faulted Lucas-cube routing remain a priority risk. Finite tests do not certify untested sizes.
title: A sharp puncture-routing metric for minimum independent domination on helm graphs
